title: Brainfile Board Schema
description: Schema for board configuration files. The board file (.brainfile/brainfile.md) defines columns, document types, and project metadata. Tasks are standalone .md files in .brainfile/board/ (active) and .brainfile/logs/ (completed), each validated against task.json.

columns.description: Board columns defining workflow stages. Task membership is declared via the column field in each task file's frontmatter.

types.description: Additions to and overrides of the document types. epic, spec, plan, task and decision are built in and need no entry; an entry under one of their names overrides it, and any other name adds a type, optionally taking a built-in's place with like. Entries under the aliases issue and adr do not configure task or decision. In strict mode a document's type must be built in or listed here.

related.description: Sister boards in other repositories, by short name. Each value is the repository folder, relative to this repository's root. A task refers to a task on one as alias:task-id. A folder that is not on this machine is still valid.

strict.description: Enables strict validation. When true, add rejects unknown document types (the built-ins are always known), move rejects unknown columns, and add, patch and lint refuse an off-pattern parent.

columns.description: Column IDs to include in progress statistics

typeEntry.description: Configuration for a document type: a type of your own, or an override of a built-in.

like.description: The built-in type whose place this one takes: its parents, children, completion rule and glyph. One of epic, spec, plan, task, decision (or the aliases issue, adr), or another type on the board. Without like, a type behaves as a task.

idPrefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated IDs (e.g., 'epic' produces 'epic-1', 'epic-2'). Defaults to the type name.

completable.description: Whether items of this type complete when moved to a completion column. Defaults to true, or to the like type's rule. A task is always completable; a decision never is.

schema.description: JSON Schema URL for validating extended fields of this type.

id.description: Unique column identifier in kebab-case. Referenced by task.column in per-task files.

order.description: Display order. Lower numbers appear first.

completionColumn.description: Marks this as a completion column. Tasks moved here are considered complete.
